title: Put all Mini PC install methods on one screen
body:
## Description

The Mini PC path asked two questions before anything happened: first "I can connect the drive" or "I need to boot from USB", then, for USB, a stick or an ISO file. This puts the three choices on one screen, the recommended one first: Create a USB installer, Write the mini PC's drive here, Save an ISO file. A Recommended pill marks the USB installer; option cards take it as a new `tag`, which screen readers hear as part of the card's description. The "Create bootable media" step is gone, so the USB installer and ISO paths are one step shorter. The processor step is unchanged.

It also fixes the Wi-Fi step showing before a processor is picked, after going back from the USB installer to writing the drive: the stick's board is now cleared until a processor is picked. The screen only sets selections and the steps follow from them, so `setSteps` and `minipcDirectSteps` are removed.

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)

- [ ] CI/CD changes

## Related Issues

Relates to home-assistant/home-assistant.io#51024: its screenshots should show the new screen.

## Testing

Unit and E2E suites pass locally in Chromium; WebKit wasn't run locally. Not run in the Tauri app or on real hardware.

title: Update cookie and url for the latest Rust advisories
body:
## Description

The Rust audit failed the release run on main on two advisories published this week:

- [RUSTSEC-2026-0594](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0594): `cookie` 0.18.2 can repeat private cookie nonces in processes that fork. Fixed in 0.18.3.
- [RUSTSEC-2026-0592](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0592): `url` 2.5.8 overflows the stack in `Url::origin()` on nested `blob:` URLs. Fixed in 2.5.9, which also brings `form_urlencoded` 1.2.3.

Only Cargo.lock changes.

title: Show the Home Assistants on the network on the welcome screen
body:
The welcome screen looks up Home Assistant over mDNS while it shows,
every 10 seconds, and lists each one it finds below Let's go with its
name and address. Each opens in the browser. One that Home Assistant OS
still installs says Installing, and one whose owner has yet to onboard
it says Not set up yet.

The new check_ha_onboarded command reads /api/onboarding, which the
onboarding integration serves without authentication until every step
is done. Announcements now carry the location_name they announce.

title: Keep the focus in the update banner when its buttons change
body:
## Description

The update banner on the welcome screen swaps its buttons as an update goes on. When Update failed with an error that can't be retried, the focused Update button made way for Download and the focus fell to the page. Not now removed the banner with the focus still in it.

The banner now notes before each update whether it holds the focus. When an update leaves nothing focused, it focuses its first button. When it has no buttons left, it sends `update-banner-closed`, and the welcome screen focuses its heading through `ViewAccessibility.restoreFocus`.

This conflicts with #648 in a few lines of `welcome-view.ts`, which that PR rewrites. Whichever lands second needs a small rebase.

title: chore(deps): update rust-dependencies
body:
This PR contains the following updates:

| Package | Type | Update | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| [mdns-sd](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd) | workspace.dependencies | minor | `0.21` → `0.22` |
| [sigstore-trust-root](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore-rust) | workspace.dependencies | minor | `0.16` → `0.17` |
| [sigstore-types](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore-rust) | workspace.dependencies | minor | `0.16` → `0.17` |
| [sigstore-verify](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore-rust) | workspace.dependencies | minor | `0.16` → `0.17` |

---

### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>keepsimple1/mdns-sd (mdns-sd)</summary>

### [`v0.22.0`](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#Version-0220-2026-11-15)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/compare/v0.21.7...v0.22.0)

#### Breaking changes

- `DaemonStatus::Running` is now `DaemonStatus::Running(RunningState)`. ([#​524](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/524))
- `ServiceDaemon::new()` and `new_with_port()` now return an error if neither the IPv4
  nor the IPv6 multicast socket can be bound, or if registering the sockets with the
  poller fails. Before, the daemon started anyway and `status()` reported `Running`.
  If only one socket fails (e.g. a host without IPv6), the daemon still runs. ([#​524](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/524))
- A service fullname read from the network now keeps its escapes, so it equals the
  registered fullname. For example, an instance named `L.A.R.A Hub` is now reported as
  `L\.A\.R\.A Hub._lara._tcp.local.` instead of `L.A.R.A Hub._lara._tcp.local.`. ([#​540](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/540))
  Use the new `instance_name_unescaped()` to get the readable instance name. ([#​552](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/552))

#### New features

- `RunningState` reports the daemon's local setup as of the `status()` request: the
  bind state (and error) of the IPv4 and IPv6 sockets, and for each enabled interface
  its addresses and whether its multicast joins worked, with the error from the last
  failed attempt. Failed joins are retried at the next IP check. ([#​524](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/524))
- Add `instance_name_unescaped()`, which returns the instance name in a fullname with
  its escapes removed. For example, `L\.A\.R\.A Hub._lara._tcp.local.` gives
  `L.A.R.A Hub`. ([#​552](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/552))

#### Bug fixes / improvements

- Stop an endless hostname rename loop caused by our own answers looping back while a
  hostname probe is in progress ([#​545](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/545)). The daemon no longer answers with records that
  are still being probed, does not treat its own addresses as a conflict, moves all of
  a host's address records on a rename, and moves the affected services back to
  `Probing` so they are announced again under the new name. ([#​548](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/548))
- Answer questions for instance names with dots in a label. Labels read from packets
  now escape `.` and `\`, so they match the registered names. ([#​540](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/540))
- Preserve label boundaries in DNS name compression, so that names like `L\.A.B.local.`
  and `L.A.B.local.` are no longer compressed into each other. ([#​542](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/542))
- Don't let a known answer with a TTL above our own suppress our answer. Some queriers
  (e.g. Android 13) list a much larger TTL, which suppressed every answer and made them
  drop the service every 2 minutes. ([#​539](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/539))

#### All changes

- `1f7068e 2026-11-16` feat: add instance_name_unescaped() to get a readable instance name ([#​552](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/552)) (keepsimple1)
- `bebe19f 2026-11-14` fix: stop the hostname rename loop caused by our own answers ([#​548](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/548)) (keepsimple1)
- `1d9aa6f 2026-11-14` fix: preserve label boundaries in DNS name compression ([#​542](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/542)) (Sealdot)
- `4774fb9 2026-11-13` feat: report detailed state in DaemonStatus::Running ([#​524](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/524)) (keepsimple1)
- `8eb02e5 2026-11-10` fix: escape dots and backslashes in labels read from packets ([#​540](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/540)) (meliodaff)
- `fc0c597 2026-11-03` fix: don't let a known answer with a TTL above ours suppress ([#​539](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/539)) (meliodaff)

Thanks and welcome our new contributors [@​Sealdot](https://redirect.github.com/Sealdot) and [@​meliodaff](https://redirect.github.com/meliodaff) !

### [`v0.21.7`](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#Version-0217-2026-11-01)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/compare/v0.21.6...v0.21.7)

This is a bugfix release.

#### Bug fixes / improvements

- Fix a race where a renamed service could skip probing. ([#​506](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/506))
- Fix query classification when the daemon runs on a custom port. Queries from the
  daemon's own port were treated as legacy unicast queries because the check was
  hard-coded to port 5353. ([#​529](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/529))
- Wake the daemon with `mio::Waker` instead of a loopback UDP signal socket. Sending a
  command no longer depends on ephemeral ports or the local UDP stack, and can no
  longer report an error after the command was already queued. ([#​527](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/527))
- Resolve Clippy warnings, including unused variables when the `logging` feature is
  off. ([#​533](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/533))
- Modernize CI workflow. ([#​530](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/530))

#### All changes

- `3beba87 2026-10-31` Modernize CI workflow ([#​530](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/530)) (oriel haim)
- `0749b87 2026-10-29` test: skip operationally down interfaces in my_ip_interfaces() ([#​535](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/535)) (keepsimple1)
- `a590a7a 2026-10-26` fix: resolve Clippy warnings ([#​533](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/533)) (oriel haim)
- `5e55075 2026-10-24` fix: reset next_send when a host rename restarts an SRV probe ([#​506](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/506)) (keepsimple1)
- `1b84730 2026-10-23` CI: move macOS tests to macos-15, run test binaries as root ([#​531](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/531)) (keepsimple1)
- `a90c138 2026-10-23` Fix custom-port mDNS query classification ([#​529](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/529)) (oriel haim)
- `36f92a4 2026-10-20` Wake the daemon poller with mio::Waker. ([#​527](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/527)) (oriel haim)

### [`v0.21.6`](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#Version-0216-2026-10-18)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/compare/v0.21.5...v0.21.6)

This is a bugfix release.

#### Bug fixes

- Fix daemon deadlocks under event backpressure. Delivering events to `browse`,
  `browse_cache` and `resolve_hostname` receivers no longer blocks the daemon. If a
  receiver falls too far behind and its event channel fills (or the receiver is
  dropped), that subscription is closed and its pending queries are stopped. In this
  case the receiver gets no `SearchStopped` event: after the queued events, the channel
  is simply disconnected. Cached records are kept, so `browse_cache` still works. ([#​522](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/522))
- Do not record an interface address whose multicast join failed. Previously such an
  address was kept (and `IpAdd` was emitted), so the IP check never retried the join.
  Now the join is retried on the next IP check. ([#​523](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/523))

#### All changes

- `9ca5b67 2026-10-16` fix: do not record an interface address whose multicast join failed ([#​523](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/523)) (keepsimple1)
- `d0941f9 2026-10-16` Fix daemon deadlocks under event backpressure ([#​522](https://redirect.github.com/keepsimple1/mdns-sd/issues/522)) (oriel haim)

Thanks and welcome our new contributor [@​orielhaim](https://redirect.github.com/orielhaim) !

</details>

<details>
<summary>sigstore/sigstore-rust (sigstore-trust-root)</summary>

### [`v0.17.0`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore-rust/releases/tag/sigstore-trust-root-v0.17.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore-rust/compare/sigstore-trust-root-v0.16.0...sigstore-trust-root-v0.17.0)

##### Added

- *(sign)* \[**breaking**] support signing without a transparency log (GitHub private instance) ([#​346](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore-rust/pull/346))

</details>
